change.item: The Monthly / Yearly switch uses an inverse translucent active state in dark sections while keeping its light-surface appearance in light sections.

addition.item: First release: pricing plans side by side, each with a name, description, badge, icon or image, monthly and yearly price, a note under the price, a list of features and a button.
A Monthly / Yearly switch with a savings badge (e.g. "Save 20%"). Prices are formatted with the currency before or after, decimals and separators; text such as "Free" shows as written.
Feature lines starting with "x " show as not included.
One plan can be highlighted: larger, with a border, or as a primary card, and shown first on phones.
Plans can come from dynamic content such as articles; texts can be translated with a multilingual plugin that reads the "translate" flag.
